intro.fr: Mario is Missing se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Mario is Missing can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: The Software Toolworks sort Mario is Missing en 1993.
text.en: The Software Toolworks releases Mario is Missing in 1993.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub TheRealSolidusSnake/Mario-Is-Missing, qui héberge l'APWorld de Mario is Missing.
text.en: The GitHub repository TheRealSolidusSnake/Mario-Is-Missing, home of the Mario is Missing APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la version 0.0.3, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (3 versions publiées).
text.en: Version 0.0.3 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (3 versions released).

text.fr: Mario is Missing figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Mario is Missing is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
